title: Japan Balance of Payments (October 2026, preliminary) — the current-account print two days before the CGPI and one day before the FOMC
source: EST: boj.or.jp/en/statistics/outline/tkohyos.xlsx ('Schedule for Releases of Statistical Data (From July 2026 to June 2027)', linked from boj.or.jp/en/statistics/outline/), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 48,500 bytes), unzipped and parsed cell-by-cell out of its 'Statistics data' sheet by this session. Section '11. Balance of Payments' row 255 labels 'Balance of Payments (Preliminary Figures, Second Preliminary Figures, Annually Revised Figures, Figures Revised for Reinvested Earnings)' at 'Around 8:50 a.m.' with column J reading '(For Oct.)', and row 256 gives that column's date as Excel serial 46364 = 2026-12-08. The same row's serial 46211 = 2026-07-08 for '(For May)' sits in the already-elapsed part of the schedule, and the decoding of this sheet was validated against an observed release on the Tankan rows (row 231's June-survey serial 46204 = 2026-07-01 matches the Bank's published 'July 1, 2026 | June 2026 Survey' archive entry). Filed estimate on three counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED:/BLS:/BEA: and no slot for the Bank of Japan or Japan's Ministry of Finance (which compiles this statistic), this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the release time is quoted only at the strength of that sheet's own 'Around 8:50 a.m.'.
notes: DISCOVERED during the japan-cgpi-2026-12-10 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), by decoding every serial in the same BoJ release-schedule sheet that fixes the CGPI and listing the ones falling in 2026-12-05 … 2026-12-15. Tracked for two reasons, neither of them tradeable. FIRST, it is the yen-relevant half of Japan's December statistical corridor: the current account is the flow this calendar's other Japanese entries (japan-cgpi-2026-12-10, japan-cpi-2026-12-18, boj-tankan-2026-12-14) do not measure, and it prints at the same 08:50 JST minute two days before the CGPI. SECOND, its Tokyo session is the LAST full Japanese bar before the December FOMC (fomc-2026-12-09, confirmed, high) — the mirror of the CGPI's, which is the first one after. The japan-cgpi-2026-12-10 ledger measures that pre-FOMC cell directly: Tokyo sessions one day before an FOMC decision run 0.402% median |opening gap| against a 0.520% pool, 0.77x, p = 0.026 on n = 152 (2006-2026) — the quiet side of the corridor, which is what makes the 12-08 bar structurally different from the 12-10 one rather than merely earlier. Impact is LOW: symbols is empty, no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed, and this calendar measures no channel from a Japanese current-account print to any tracked name. Precedent for filing a non-MPM Japanese statistical release read off this sheet as its own entry: japan-cgpi-2026-12-10 and boj-tankan-2026-12-14, both kind 'macro-print'.
